description: Official implementation of WHALE (Weight-Harness Alternating Learning)
summary: WHALE's core move—alternating small RSFT weight updates with a Meta-Harness search over tools, context, and control flow instead of treating the two as independent levers—is exactly the framing I keep running into when I build PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket, where the harness is where most of the actual engineering lives. What sells it to me is the small-model result: Qwen 2B/4B agents on AIME and Lichess puzzles getting real accuracy gains from harness co-optimization, which is a concrete argument that I don't need a bigger model, I need a better scaffold around a small one. The repo is also refreshingly scoped—three domains, four ablation conditions, one shared `alternate.sh` loop—so I can actually read the meta-harness proposer and lift the search structure without wading through a research framework.
